name: flowguard-mobile
_comment: Versions above were current when this was written and WILL drift. Don't copy them verbatim - run `npx create-expo-app flowguard-mobile --template blank-typescript`, then `npx expo install firebase @react-navigation/native @react-navigation/bottom-tabs expo-image-picker expo-location @react-native-async-storage/async-storage`, then copy in the src/ and App.tsx files. `expo install` (not plain npm install) matters - it picks versions matched to your Expo SDK.
